chunks.text: We would now like to discuss drag

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: forces in a fluid.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: Now remember that fluids can be both a liquid or air.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: And drag forces are actually quite complicated,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: depending on a lot of factors.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: If we had an object falling in a fluid,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: the drag forces can depend on both the properties

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: of the object.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: And in that case, it might be the speed or the size or the shape

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: It can depend on the density of the fluid.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: It can depend on a property that

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: measures the resistance of the fluid,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: something which will refer to as viscosity,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: and also a property about the compressibility of the fluid.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: So in general, this is quite complicated.

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.text: Now let's begin our modeling by considering

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: what we call air drag.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: Now in air drag, objects that are moving,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: and will consider objects that are moving rapidly.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: So our objects are moving very fast.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: Now in that case, we can make a rough model of the air drag

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: as follows.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: The magnitude of this force is going

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: to be proportional to the speed squared.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: There'll be a factor where it's the cross-sectional area

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: that the object presents in the motion, perpendicular

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: to the plane of motion.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: It can depend on the density of the air.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: And traditionally, there are a couple of coefficients

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: in here that are dimensionless, that

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: are empirically determined by the shape of the object.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: And that's called the drag coefficient.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: And in fact, there's also a factor one half in the way

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: this law is traditionally written.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: So what we have here is a resistive force,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: which is proportional to the speed squared,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: and depends on the properties of the air, the density of the air,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: and some physical parameter properties of the object itself.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: Now this drag coefficient, we can have a table that

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: can represent that.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: And you can see here that for a variety of different shapes,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: the drag coefficient is somewhere on the order of 1.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: So this is an example of what we refer to as air drag.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: When we drop objects in a fluid at very slow speeds,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: we have a different effect than what we talked about air drag.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: For example, if we drop a marble in molasses

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: and drop the same marble in water,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: we see a very different motion.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: And that depends on a property of the fluid, which

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: will refer to as viscosity.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: Now we'll denote a coefficient of viscosity by the symbol

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: N, eta.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: Now when we drop an object in a fluid that the drag force in magnitude

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: will be proportional to both viscosity,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: will be proportional to the speed,

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: and it will be proportional to the viscosity.

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: And now for very special cases, so for the special case,

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation
chunks.text: we can get an exact solution for this drag force.

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation

chunks.title: differentiation
